evals.prompt: This is a fresh project with no index. Initialize Hermes-Index, then create a folder `src` and a file `src/app.py`. Record the file work with the action 'Write the entry point'. Show me the final IDs.
evals.expected_output: h_index.md is initialized and maintained through the helper. src is /A, src/app.py is /A/1, and the map contains the short action. Real files and folders keep their names.
expectations: The agent runs the Hermes-Index init command rather than creating h_index.md by hand.
h_index.md exists at the project root with codes: and map: sections.
src is indexed as /A and src/app.py as /A/1.
The map contains a folder creation entry for /A and an entry for /A/1 with the action 'Write the entry point'.
Real folders and files keep their names; no IDs are used in filesystem names.
If the project is a Git repository, h_index.md is excluded through .git/info/exclude rather than .gitignore.

evals.prompt: The project already has h_index.md with /A = src/ and /A/1 = src/main.py. Add a new module src/auth.py, then refactor src/main.py to call it. Keep the existing IDs stable.
evals.expected_output: The agent maintains the existing index without reinitializing it. The new module receives a new ID under /A, the existing /A/1 still points to src/main.py, and both changes are logged.
expectations: The agent reads the existing index instead of reinitializing or overwriting it.
src/auth.py appears in codes: with a new ID under /A.
/A/1 is still mapped to src/main.py after the refactor.
The map contains short base-form actions for the new module and the refactor, with no paths or parentheses.
The helper verify command passes after the changes.

evals.prompt: Refactor the parser in this repository.
evals.expected_output: The project has no h_index.md. The agent checks for one, offers initialization once, explains that it is hidden and Git-excluded, and does not create it before consent.
expectations: The agent checks for h_index.md before editing files.
The agent offers initialization exactly once and waits for a decision.
No h_index.md is created before the user consents.
The offer mentions that the index is hidden/local and excluded from Git.
The agent does not silently create an index in the project root or a subfolder.

evals.prompt: In the indexed project, rename src/auth/login.py to src/auth/session.py and update all references. Use the existing index.
evals.expected_output: The agent uses the helper move command. The file keeps its original ID, codes: shows the new path, map: records the move, and verify passes.
expectations: The agent uses the Hermes-Index move command instead of only renaming the file.
The file ID in codes: is unchanged after the rename.
The old path no longer appears in codes:.
The new path appears in codes: with the same ID.
The map records a move entry with a short base-form action.
The helper verify command passes.

evals.prompt: In the indexed project, delete src/old.py and add src/new.py in the same folder. Do not reuse the deleted file's number.
evals.expected_output: The deleted ID leaves codes: but remains in map: and state. src/new.py receives a fresh number, never the retired one. The index verifies.
expectations: src/old.py no longer appears in codes:.
The deleted ID and its history remain in map:.
src/new.py appears in codes: with a new ID that is not the deleted file's ID.
The new file number is not a reuse of the deleted number.
The helper verify command passes.

evals.prompt: In the indexed project, create 27 sibling folders under docs and tell me the 27th folder's ID. Keep the real folder names unchanged.
evals.expected_output: The first 26 folders receive /A/A through /A/Z under the docs folder. The 27th receives a deterministic 2+ letter segment under /A and remains unique. No real folder name contains an ID.
expectations: The first 26 child folders receive single-letter IDs A through Z under docs.
The 27th child folder receives an ID segment of two or more letters.
All 27 folder IDs are unique and follow the Hermes-Index grammar.
Real folder names are not changed to include IDs.
The helper verify command passes.
